scripts.types:bindings: wrangler types src/worker-configuration.d.ts --env-interface CloudflareBindings --include-runtime false --strict-vars false
scripts.check:bindings: wrangler types src/worker-configuration.d.ts --env-interface CloudflareBindings --include-runtime false --strict-vars false --check
scripts.deploy: pnpm run verify:config && pnpm run check:bindings && pnpm run prepare:deploy-config && wrangler deploy --config .wrangler/deploy/wrangler.production.toml
scripts.migrate:production: pnpm run prepare:deploy-config && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config .wrangler/deploy/wrangler.production.toml
